display.title: PostHog capture and feature-flag API
display.summary: Capture single or batched events and evaluate feature flags remotely through the public project-token runtime API. The complete surface has only the three documented POST endpoints; requests can write analytics data or consume flag quota, so Pontx Hub never proxies, caches, or executes them and callers connect directly through the local SDK/CLI after preview and confirmation.

documentation.stabilityNote: The complete boundary is the three POST endpoints in the public project-token runtime surface at a fixed official documentation revision: single-event capture, batch capture, and remote feature-flag evaluation. It excludes the personal-API-key management surface, /flags/definitions local evaluation, SSE/workflow APIs, static assets, and deprecated /capture, /engage, and /decide routes. The documentation contents/ tree is MIT-licensed; the PontxSpec and SDK are independently authored. Hub never retains project tokens, proxies, caches, or executes these requests. Callers use their own PostHog project and the local SDK/CLI, review a preview first, and explicitly confirm any request with side effects or quota impact.

pricing.summary: PostHog Cloud uses usage-based pricing with free allowances; event capture and feature-flag evaluation can both affect account usage. Refer to PostHog's current pricing page for allowances, metering units, and prices.

credentials.description: A caller-owned PostHog project token. Keep it only in a local environment variable or SDK option; never put it in Hub, logs, examples, or chat.
